{{Quote|There is no passion. There is only peace, daughter. You must control your emotions, Malincha. Your fear.|Malincha's parent|<ref name="Legacy 45" />}}
An [[Color/Legends|orange]]-skinned '''Devaronian''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[New Jedi Order]]<ref name="Legacy 45" /> at some point before [[130 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /> The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] was considered a rarity, as there were not many Jedi of their [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Jedi had orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]], and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a silver [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]].<ref name="Legacy 45" />

At some point, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Reproduction/Legends|daughter]] was born to the Jedi on<ref name="Legacy 45" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The child's [[Parent/Legends|parents]] named her [[Darth Maladi|Malincha]]. The Jedi advised Malincha to learn to control both her fear and her emotions, reciting different parts of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. However, they and Malincha's other parent were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[One Sith]], [[Darth Krayt]],<ref name="Legacy 45" /> at some point before 130 ABY.<ref name="Legacy 1" /> After her parents' deaths, Malincha was [[Sith training|trained]] by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ways, eventually becoming the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] Darth Maladi.<ref name="Legacy 45" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Maladi's parent appeared in flashbacks in the [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> The issue was published on [[February 24]], [[2010]]<ref name="Release Date">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-336/Star-Wars-Legacy-45----Monster-part-3|text=Star Wars: Legacy #45}}</ref> and was written by [[John Ostrander]] with illustrations by [[Jan Duursema]], [[Dan Parsons]], and [[Brad Anderson]].<ref name="Legacy 45" />
